title: Wall Climber
description: Allows you to walk on walls using the Gravity API mod.
body:
Allows you to walk on walls using the Gravity mod. 

Watch the video about it [here](https://youtu.be/kqaBYjnQD2Q) for more information.

I do not plan on updating this datapack.

Please credit me if you use this datapack in any sort of public or profitable manner.
